in_sanskrit.name: Devarth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Godlike, Divine
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Devarth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Devarth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Arth' meaning 'Sense'. It symbolizes the divine sense or understanding of the universe and one's place in it. This name is revered in Hindu mythology for those who aspire to live a life rooted in spiritual awareness and divine connection.
